name: rainbow-tag-system
description: Makes every part or object tagged with the CollectionService tag 'Rainbow' continuously cycle through rainbow colors in perfect sync, including objects spawned after the script starts.
requires: Uses Roblox CollectionService and a server Script.

code: if accumulator < SETTINGS.UpdateInterval then return end

adapt: Use the Tag Editor in Roblox Studio to add the tag Rainbow to any BasePart or Model.
Change RainbowSpeed to control how quickly the colors cycle.
Change UpdateInterval to control how frequently colors update.
For a Model, the script colors all BasePart descendants.
test: 1. Put the Script in ServerScriptService. 2. Create a Part in Workspace. 3. Open View > Tag Editor. 4. Add the tag Rainbow to the Part. 5. Start a playtest and watch the Part continuously change colors. 6. Spawn another Part while the game is running and add the Rainbow tag to it. 7. Verify that both Parts immediately show the same rainbow color and stay synchronized. 8. Try tagging a Model to make all its BaseParts change colors together.
notes: Rainbow colors are calculated from one shared server-side clock, not individual part timers. Newly tagged or spawned objects immediately receive the current rainbow color, so they stay synchronized with existing objects. Models color all BasePart descendants. Changes replicate to clients because the server controls the colors. Only BaseParts are recolored; meshes and other visual objects that are not BaseParts are not directly supported.
